item.title: Eastern Europe’s Accelerator Conundrum: Slovakia’s Startup Ecosystem
item.description: Slovakia’s startup ecosystem is emerging steadily, centered in Bratislava, with growing activity in Košice and Žilina. While smaller than neighboring Central European markets, Slovakia has a pool of highly skilled IT talent, producing promising IT and IT-enabled services ventures. Yet, the Accelerator Conundrum is evident: founders often focus on securing early funding rather than building a validated, revenue-generating business. item.title: Baltic Accelerator Conundrum: Estonia’s Startup Ecosystem
item.description: Estonia is the poster child of digital transformation. Founders in Tallinn and Tartu have proven that a small country can build world-class technology companies — Skype, Wise, Bolt, Pipedrive, and Veriff are all powerful testaments to that spirit. item.title: Baltic Accelerator Conundrum: Latvia’s Startup Ecosystem
item.description: Latvia has come a long way since the early 2010s when its startup ecosystem was barely visible on the European map.
